Amazon Prime Air is the company's drone delivery service, which today announced a major expansion of its service area. By the end of 2026, it will cover nearly 500 US cities. Below are the areas where Amazon drone delivery will be launched next.

Amazon Prime Air will cover nearly 500 US cities by the end of 2026

Amazon's Prime Air service is expanding rapidly, with plans to cover nearly 500 cities and towns across the US by the end of 2026 — six times its current scale — bringing ultra-fast drone delivery to tens of millions of customers nationwide. Prime Air offers the largest selection of items available for drone delivery, including millions of groceries, electronics, beauty products, medications and household items, sold at everyday low prices with delivery in as fast as 30 minutes.

Prime Air currently serves the following areas:

  • Tolleson, Arizona (Phoenix metropolitan area)
  • Ruskin, Florida (Tampa metropolitan area)
  • Kansas City, Kansas
  • Papillion, Nebraska (Omaha metropolitan area)
  • Baton Rouge, Louisiana
  • Hazel Park, Michigan (Detroit metropolitan area)
  • Pontiac, Michigan (Detroit metropolitan area)
  • Richmond, Texas (Houston metropolitan area)
  • San Antonio, Texas
  • Richardson, Texas (Dallas metropolitan area)
  • Waco, Texas

Drone delivery will陆续 launch in the following metropolitan areas: Chicago, Illinois; Syracuse, New York; Cleveland, Ohio; Atlanta, Georgia; and Boise, Idaho. Amazon added: "More communities will be joining later."

Prime members can enjoy free drone delivery on orders of $50 or more. Orders under $50 require a $2.99 delivery fee, while non-Prime members using drone delivery will be charged $4.99.

Is Amazon's drone delivery service available in your area? What has your experience been like? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
